api_breadth.value: Large read-write surface: 28 official product connector packages (Spot, Margin, COIN-M/USDS-M Futures, Options, Portfolio Margin, Wallet, Sub-Account, Simple Earn, Staking, Mining, Pay, Convert, Copy Trading), with endpoints classified MARKET_DATA, USER_DATA, TRADE and USER_STREAM.

auth_methods.quote: API-KEY所对应的API-Secret作为 `HMAC SHA256` 的密钥,其他所有参数作为`HMAC SHA256`的操作对象,得到的输出即为签名。

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Four scopes: market data, account, trade (Spot, Margin, Convert, USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures) and transfers within the sub-account.

access_notes.value: Self-serve: register a Binance account, create API key/secret and toggle per-key permissions (read account, trade, withdraw) in the web user center, signing requests with HMAC-SHA256. Documented testnets exist (Spot: testnet.binance.vision per the OpenAPI servers; Futures: testnet.binancefuture.com). No plan-tier, app-review, partner, or sales-contact gate appears in the evidence; production use additionally requires a funded account (not documented in captured sources). Brokerage/Binance Link sub-account API-key endpoints are a separate broker-oriented API.

official_mcp_server.quote: Binance MCP Server: one endpoint URL plus an authorization flow connects a supported agent. No API keys are stored locally.

community_mcp_servers.quote: MCP server for Binance exchange - spot trading, staking, wallet, NFT, pay, mining, and more

rate_limits.value: IP-based (not per API key); HTTP 429 warning then HTTP 418 IP ban; repeat violations extend bans from 2 minutes up to 3 days. Per-endpoint request weights and order-rate limits are also documented via the rateLimits array in exchangeInfo and the X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-(intervalNum)(intervalLetter) header.
rate_limits.quote: 频繁违反限制,封禁时间会逐渐延长 ,对于重复违反者,将会被封从2分钟到3天。 - 访问限制是基于IP的,而不是API Key

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Versioned REST paths (e.g., /sapi/v1, /sapi/v2, /sapi/v3 per product); deprecations announced in a change log with a notice window before removal — legacy broker endpoints 'will be deleted in a month' with migration to v3 urged. Official connector docs also state legacy unified connector packages remain available only 'for a limited time'.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Following endpoints will be deleted in a month: `GET /sapi/v1/broker/subAccount/futuresSummary`,`GET /sapi/v2/broker/subAccount/futuresSummary`. Please migrate the usage of legacy version(v1&v2) to the new (v3) version as soon as possible.

verdict_reason: Binance publishes broad public REST and WebSocket documentation (Spot OpenAPI spec, Futures API docs, 28 official connector packages) and developers obtain key/secret credentials self-serve from the account user center with HMAC-SHA256 signing. Documented testnets exist for Spot and Futures, and no plan-tier, app-review, or sales-contact gate appears in the evidence. Only routine friction remains: request signing and per-IP weight-based rate limits.
open_questions: Input hint binance-docs.github.io is unreliable: the root https://binance-docs.github.io returns a GitHub Pages 404, and /apidocs/spot/en/ only shows a redirect to https://developers.binance.com/docs/binance-spot-api-docs; the canonical first-party docs site was not directly captured.

The Binance MCP Server is only described in an official Binance research article; no dedicated developer documentation page or concrete MCP endpoint URL was captured, so official_mcp_server cites the announcement page (endpoint likely per-agent/undisclosed).

Whether the Agent OS / Binance MCP Server authorization flow is OAuth 2.0 specifically is not stated; 'four scopes' is the only scope documentation found, while core REST APIs use API key + HMAC-SHA256 with no OAuth scopes documented.
Exact numeric rate-limit caps (e.g., request weight per minute per IP) were not enumerated in the captured text; the concrete weight values live in exchangeInfo rateLimits on the Futures docs.

No pricing/plans page was captured, so self_serve_free is inferred from documented self-service API-key management in the user center; whether a verified/KYC account or minimum balance is required for production API keys is not documented in the evidence.
Webhooks are marked false because only WebSocket market/user data streams (listenKey) are documented; absence of any HTTP webhook/callback product should be confirmed on the canonical docs site.
Only the JavaScript/TypeScript official connector suite was captured; other official Binance SDKs (e.g., Python) may exist but were not in the evidence.
Versioning/deprecation evidence comes from the Binance Link (Brokerage) API change log; the Spot/Futures general deprecation and sunset policy was not captured.
Two MCP pages tagged OFFICIAL=yes in the search bundle (nirholas.github.io, chrisleekr.github.io) are clearly third-party projects and were treated as community servers.
Composio catalog search for 'Binance' returned zero toolkits (items: []), so composio_toolkit_exists=false.
